reason: Three free months and nothing to install next to my terminal, so I would try it; seeing who comes back and rewarding my regulars is something I do in my head now. Whether I keep paying after the free months depends on whether my guests actually use the QR.
objection: Will my guests, a lot of them older neighbourhood regulars, really pay by QR instead of handing me a card or cash, and how much is the payment partner's fee on top of the 59 lari, because my margins are thin.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free months fewer than a third of my tables pay by QR, or the per-transaction fee turns out higher than my bank terminal's, I would cancel.
